## About
Jokers of Aggieland is a members only poker club in College Station, Texas. We offer daily cash and tournament poker, with Texas Hold'em, Omaha and more on the tables.
Alongside our weekly tournaments, we host special scheduled events. Memberships can be bought daily, monthly or annually, and players have given us a 4.6 rating across 31 Google reviews.

## Services
- Daily cash poker: Cash poker every day, including Texas Hold'em, Omaha and more.
- Tournaments: Regularly scheduled weekly tournaments plus special scheduled events.
- Yearly membership: A full year of membership at the club. Seat rental fee is separate. ($50)

## FAQ
Q: Do I need to be a member to play?
A: Yes. Jokers of Aggieland is a members only poker club. Memberships can be purchased daily, monthly or annually.

Q: Does a membership include the seat rental fee?
A: No. Memberships do not include the seat rental fee.

Q: How do I find out what games are running?
A: Join our GroupMe group for daily updates on games and events, or reach out through the contact form on our website.
